These principles form a dual structure: compact sets approximate open sets via μ, while functionals Λ map to measures. Failure modes arise when μ lacks regularity or when compact sets fail to approximate open sets effectively. The derivation hinges on the linearity of both integration and functional evaluation, allowing reduction to indicator functions with values in [0,1].
